The m14 measurements at 10/1 and 50/1 were nearly unchanged, reinforcing molecule-specific solvent response. Chemical interpretation is also corrected: 0/1 denotes pure EA mobile phase, DCM denotes loading solvent, m103 is a monoiodo ester, and m199 is a sulfoxide.","batch_rationale":"The batch uses failures to formulate discriminating experiments while extending coverage where the model currently relies on chemical transfer. The m32 and m81 additions complete two small loading-by-ratio comparisons; m204 links a major historical failure to both a fixed-loading solvent curve and a loading contrast. Follow-ups on m11, m103, m44 and m173 test whether corrected labels support the surrounding predicted response, while only one adjacent-loading measurement is devoted to the unusual m124 result. Exploration targets related, reusable structural distinctions: beta-ketoester substitution, amino-group position, pyridyl ester versus ketone, quinoline substitution, OH spacing, sulfur versus oxygen environments, and constrained versus remote ether placement. The m78 and m17 pairs provide controlled response information for new molecules, with m17 testing a specific predicted reversal. Compact predictions for m19, m178 and the stronger-solvent m78 point help cover plausible failure regions outside the high-volume tail. Many routine halogenated references performed reasonably in the previous batch, reducing the immediate value of more near-equivalent references. Together, these labels should improve structure-condition interpolation and transfer across the Row-distribution, although unrecorded variation and uncalibrated single-model quantiles limit confidence in individual acquisition expectations."}
